descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-19 Medication Tracker · S08 Nursing Home, live: the pre-round fills the resident's Medications panel; a hold, a repeat hold and a conditional restart

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U12 Nursing Home has its own Medications panel, filled from the pre-round (PR #56). (UAT TC-19 ER 9; TFA-92597 AC 3)
  • U13 A repeat hold on a held drug changes nothing; a held or stopped row never resets to active unless a restart is dictated. (UAT TC-19 ER 9; TFA-92597 R5)
  • U4 'Continue / keep / stays on X' is not an event: no re-dating, no Held, no new row. (UAT TC-19 ER 1; TFA-92597 R4)
  • U5 A conditional or future order ('restart tomorrow if K is fine') never changes today's status. (UAT TC-19 ER 2; TFA-92597 R1)
  • U8 Hold/stop dates and reasons are the ones dictated and are kept on every later save; they are never changed to the save date. (UAT TC-19 ER 5; UAT TC-19 ER 10; TFA-92597 R6)
  • U18 The step mix (starts, holds, stops, dose changes, conditional orders, one-time doses) is dictated across two days and passes in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT TC-19 Steps; UAT 3.3)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Fresh physician with the fixture Nursing Home resident (no medications); live models

When Three pre-round Save Notes in a row, each replacing the whole pre-round text

Then After save 1 the panel lists the four chronic drugs with no change tag. After save 2 metformin is Held · today with a reason naming intake; amlodipine and donepezil unchanged; vitamin D still listed. After save 3 metformin is still Held with the same date and the same reason; no Started tag; nothing else changed

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs per checkpoint, page-wide. The Nursing Home Pre-Round page repeats the saved text: the collapsed one-liner is a button whose name is the first 60 characters of the pre-round text (snf PreRoundTab.tsx), so dictated words ('intake', 'remains on hold', 'eating better') are never used in page-wide checks. …

Where it ran: dev unit U40; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S08 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-19.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 25acd72 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-15T14:04:39Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: AICHECK · AI output check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
